body.chatPrefill: Hi! I have a question about my {region}:

info.neck: Seven vertebrae that carry the head. Long screen time stiffens this area; gentle movement keeps it mobile.
info.shoulders: The most mobile joint in the body, sensitive to posture and repetitive loads.
info.chest: Ribs, breastbone and the muscles that open the chest. A rounded sitting posture tightens it.
info.upperBack: Thoracic spine and shoulder blades: support for breathing and an upright posture.
info.spine: The whole column from neck to tailbone. Mobility and strength around it protect the discs.
info.lowerBack: Five lumbar vertebrae, the most loaded part of the spine in daily life.
info.elbows: Hinge joints between upper arm and forearm; often tired from desk work and lifting.
info.wrists: Small bones and tendons for fine motor control and support on the hands.
info.pelvis: Links the spine to the legs and sets the base of posture and gait.
info.hips: Deep ball-and-socket joints; their mobility affects the back and knees.
info.knees: Stability for walking, running and squatting; depend on hip and ankle mobility.
info.shins: Lower leg bones and calves; carry the load of every step.
info.feet: The foundation: arches and ankles decide how load travels up the body.

connect.title: Connect Apple Health
connect.lead: One permission screen, your data stays yours. Here is what the app would ask for and where things stand.

web.title: Not available in the browser
web.body: Apple Health opens only to the native iOS app. The web version and the Home-screen shortcut cannot reach it, so there is no connect button here. Fill the numbers you care about manually in My health.

ios.title: iOS app without the Health module yet
ios.body: This build of the KINEZIS LIVE app does not include the Apple Health bridge. An update will add it; the permission screen will appear then.

android.title: Apple Health is an iOS feature
android.body: On Android the matching service is Health Connect. It is planned separately; manual entry works today.

connect.categoriesTitle: What the app will ask for and why

steps.title: Steps and distance
steps.why: Daily movement in one place with your sessions.

workouts.title: Workouts and active minutes
workouts.why: Sessions you record on the watch count towards your weekly goal.

heart.title: Heart rate and resting heart rate
heart.why: Shown as context for recovery. Never interpreted as a diagnosis.

sleep.title: Sleep duration
sleep.why: Helps you see recovery next to training. No sleep scores invented.

breathing.title: Respiratory rate (if the watch records it)
breathing.why: Optional context for the breathing practices.

connect.categoriesNote: Only the types you allow are read. Each one can be refused separately in the system prompt and switched off later in the Health app.

flow.1: You tap Connect in the iOS app.
flow.2: The app explains the categories above.
flow.3: iOS shows its own permission screen, type by type.
flow.4: The app reads only what you allowed, nothing else.
flow.5: Allowed numbers appear on Home and in My health with the source label Apple Health.
flow.6: If you decline, everything keeps working and manual entry stays available.

privacy.1: Health data is never shared with third parties and never shown to other members.
privacy.2: You can revoke each permission at any time in iOS Settings → Health → Data access.
privacy.3: Manual, estimated and imported numbers are always labelled with their source.
privacy.4: Nothing is shown as connected until data has actually been received.

connect.manualNote: Until the native bridge ships, My health is fully manual: weight, measurements, water and your activity log.

admin.reviewLead: Trainers' sessions and programmes waiting for a decision.
admin.noReviewBody: New publications from trainers appear here.
admin.reviewNote: Check safety wording, medical claims and video quality. Rejected items return to the author with your note.
admin.reportsLead: Members' reports on sessions, posts, trainers and comments.
admin.trainersLead: Author cards, verification and publishing status.
admin.verifyNote: Verify only after a real check of documents. The badge is shown separately from likes and completions.

mind.title: Mind and rest
mind.lead: Short practices for attention, calm and a gentle end of the day.
mind.disclaimer: These practices support well-being. They do not diagnose or treat anxiety, depression, insomnia or pain. If you feel persistently low or unsafe, contact a doctor or a local helpline.
mind.breatheBody: Paced breathing practices with the evidence behind them.

timer.doneBody: Finished. Take a moment before you move on.
timer.loggedGuest: Done. Sign in to keep a history.

break.title: Screen break
break.lead: About two and a half minutes for the neck, shoulders, hands and eyes.

evening.title: Evening ritual
evening.lead: Calm breathing, a few floor stretches and one line of gratitude.
evening.breathIntro: Three minutes of slow breathing with a longer exhale.
evening.stretchIntro: Lie on a mat or the bed. Move slowly, nothing should hurt.
evening.gratitudeQuestion: What was good today, even something small?
evening.gratitudePlaceholder: A warm cup of tea, a walk, a kind word…
evening.gratitudeNote: Optional. Saved in your journal for today; only you can see it.
evening.savedSigned: The ritual is saved to your activity and journal.
evening.savedGuest: Saved on this device. Sign in to keep a history.

journal.title: Well-being journal
journal.lead: Mood, energy, sleep and tension in one tap a day. Patterns appear over the weeks.
journal.doneBody: Today's marks are saved. Come back tomorrow.
journal.empty: No marks yet. Start with today above.
journal.disclaimer: The journal is for noticing patterns, not for diagnosis. If low mood or poor sleep lasts more than two weeks, talk to a doctor.
journal.privacySigned: Saved to your account. Only you can see it; it is never shown to trainers or other members.
journal.privacyGuest: Saved on this device only. Sign in to keep it across devices.

challenges.title: Gentle challenges
challenges.lead: A week of small habits. Missed days are simply not counted, nothing resets.
challenges.note: Progress is counted from what you finish in the app on this device; water uses your daily goal.
challenges.ended: The week is over: {count} days done. Every day counts.

breath7.title: 7 days of breathing
breath7.body: One finished breathing practice a day, {target} of {window} days.

meditate7.title: Meditation week
meditate7.body: Meditate on {target} of {window} days, any length.

water7.title: Water week
water7.body: Reach your water goal {target} of {window} days. Never force it.

breaks5.title: Kind to your neck
breaks5.body: Take a screen break on {target} of {window} days.

sounds.title: Sounds and music
sounds.lead: Rain, sea, wind and calm music without words. They keep playing when you move to other screens.
sounds.note: Keep the volume low. With a timer the sound fades out on its own.

shop.title: Everything for practice
shop.lead: Equipment for home practice, chosen to match the KINEZIS LIVE sessions.
shop.widgetBody: Mats, blocks, bands and whatever the library sessions call for.
shop.emptyBody: We are choosing products and partners. The categories are ready; the first items will appear here.
shop.emptyCategoryBody: Products for this category are still being chosen.
shop.howItWorks: You buy on the partner's site, where price, delivery and returns are shown. KINEZIS LIVE may earn a commission; your price stays the same.
shop.suspensionNote: Mount suspension systems only as the manufacturer instructs and to a solid anchor. If unsure, ask a professional installer.

mats.title: Mats
mats.lead: Yoga and Pilates mats, covers, bags and cleaning sprays.

props.title: Blocks and props
props.lead: Blocks, straps, bolsters, meditation cushions and knee pads.

bands.title: Bands
bands.lead: Resistance loops, fabric bands, latex bands and rehab expanders.

balance.title: Balls and balance
balance.lead: Fitballs, small balls, half-domes, balance boards and cushions.

weights.title: Weights
weights.lead: Light dumbbells, wrist and ankle weights, medicine balls and soft balls.

recovery.title: Recovery and release
recovery.lead: Foam rollers, massage balls, Duoball and spiky balls.

suspension.title: Suspension
suspension.lead: Suspension trainers, gymnastic rings, door anchors and aerial hammocks.

accessories.title: Accessories
accessories.lead: Grip socks, gloves, jump ropes and hand grippers.

community.title: Community
community.lead: Members' stories, questions and tips on back care, mobility, recovery and nutrition.
community.flagged: Published and sent to a moderator: it contains phrases that look like a cure claim or advice to stop treatment. Please share your own experience without promises to others.
community.emptyBody: Share your experience or ask the first question.
community.personalNote: This is a member's personal experience, not medical advice. What helped one person may not suit you.
community.endorsedNote: A KINEZIS LIVE specialist read this post and saw no unsafe advice. It is not a personal recommendation.
community.redFlag: Numbness, weakness, or sharp or sudden pain need a doctor first. Do not choose exercises based on community tips.

rules.1: Write about your own experience; do not promise results to others.
rules.2: Do not advise anyone to stop treatment or medication.
rules.3: Severe or sudden pain, numbness or weakness need a doctor first.
rules.title: Before you post

rulesList.1: We share personal experience, not diagnoses or cure claims.
rulesList.2: No advice to stop treatment and no selling.
rulesList.3: Respect for members: no insults or pressure.
rulesList.4: See unsafe advice? Tap "Report" on the post page.

admin.flaggedHint: Posts with phrases like "cures", "guaranteed", "stop your meds". Members can see them; hide unsafe ones or mark them checked.
